tbesh_html:
Hananeel = "God has favoured"
the name of a tower in Jerusalem
Combined with mig.dal (מִגְדָּל " Tower" H4026)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named
strongs_1890.derivation: from H2603 (חָנַן) and H410 (אֵל); God has favored;
